content.value: A silica optical fiber with a core diameter large enough to be considered by ray theory has a core refractive index of 1.49 and a cladding refractive index of 1.47. Estimate (i) the critical angle at the core-cladding interface, (ii) the NA of the fiber, and (iii) the acceptance angle in air.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
